svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Square: four 380 mm lengths of 40 x 40 x 4 angle, mitred 45 deg at each

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: end, horizontal legs pointing inward, top faces flat and level.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld the corners; check the diagonals agree within 2 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Legs: four 70 mm lengths of the same angle, fitted inside each corner,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: tight under the horizontal legs and against the vertical legs; weld.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Feet: four 80 x 80 x 5 mm plates welded under the legs, reaching

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outward; one 13 mm anchor hole in each, 208 mm from the centre lines.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Pipe stops: four 30 x 20 x 5 mm flat bars welded upright on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: horizontal legs at the middle of each side, inner face 158.5 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: from the centre (1 mm outside the housing).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Tie rod holes: 11 mm in each corner, 170 mm from both centre lines.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Clean the welds, then galvanize or paint the whole frame. Never weld after galvanizing.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: top flat within 1 mm; the housing drops in between the stops.
